_note: Hand-written product records for the storefront preview. Printify IDs are Printify product IDs, not Shopify variant IDs. Variants, availability, images, and swatch colors come from printify-snapshot.json (read-only, Nov 7, 2026). Approved colors are checked against that snapshot by build.js.

cc1717.name: Comfort Colors 1717 garment-dyed tee
fabric: Garment-dyed for a soft, lived-in color
care: Iron, steam, or dry on low heat

g18500.name: Gildan 18500 Heavy Blend hooded sweatshirt
fabric: Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem
care_dtg: Iron on low heat, avoiding the artwork
care_embroidery: Iron on low heat, avoiding the embroidery

products.name: Midnight Rock Hunt Tee
products.decoration: Direct-to-garment (DTG) print on the left chest and the back.
products.blurb: A small emblem up front and a whole moonlit shoreline on the back.
products.story: The left chest carries a small Heavy Pockets emblem with a Petoskey stone and wildflowers. The back is a big moonlit rocky-shore scene: pines, lake waves, wildflowers, and familiar beach stones.

products.name: Great Lakes Rock Crew Tee
products.blurb: Four friendly finds, ready for a beach day.
products.story: A Petoskey stone, a Lake Superior agate, a puddingstone, and a Leland Blue walk across the front together, each with a little face.

products.name: Field Notebook Tee
products.blurb: A page from a rock hunter's notebook.
products.story: Fine line drawings of crystals, beach stones, a rock hammer, a flashlight, plants, and a box turtle, laid out like a page from a field notebook.

products.name: Pocket Full of Treasures Tee
products.decoration: Printed left-chest artwork. The pocket is part of the print, not a sewn pocket.
products.story: A small printed pocket on the left chest, stuffed with a Petoskey stone, an agate, a puddingstone, a Leland Blue, and wildflowers.

products.name: Shoreline Hoodie
products.decoration: Direct-to-garment (DTG) print on the left chest and the back.
products.blurb: For slow walks along the shore.
products.story: A small floral Petoskey-stone emblem sits on the left chest. The back carries a large moonlit rocky-shore scene with pines, wildflowers, lake waves, and familiar beach stones.

products.name: Floral Butterfly Embroidered Hoodie
products.decoration: Embroidery, centered on the chest. Plain back.
products.blurb: Small stitched details for everyday wandering.
products.story: A two-tone embroidered heavy pockets wordmark with two flowers and a tiny butterfly landing beside the yellow bloom. The back is plain.
